text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Fuhahahaha...!!
Ah, so the truth... is this crystal clear.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Naturally.
For I am—the King.

text_block_list.name: Band Member A
text_block_list.text:
...!!
S-so fast...!

text_block_list.name: Band Member A
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, awesome.
Awesome... so awesomeee...!!

text_block_list.name: Band Members
text_block_list.text: ...Gooo, Orfevre~~!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—She's strong! Strong, Orfevre...!
She's overwhelmingly strong!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre achieves the Triple Crown!!
The 7th Triple Crown Umamusume in history is born...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Uwooooah...!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Listen to these massive cheers! The joyous cries for the first Triple Crown Umamusume in a long time just won't stop...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Frenzy. Smiles. Excitement... For many, that whirlwind of emotion was something meant to be kept hidden.
And yet now... it is reborn.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Brought forth by the awakening majesty of a single, powerful Umamusume.
choice_data_list: (So this is the power of racing...!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: That's right.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Shout until your voice goes dry! Scream!
For the King!!

text_block_list.name: Band Member A
text_block_list.text:
...O-Oooohh...!!
She's so cool!! Right... Ah.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
See, gets you hyped, right? It's got insane power, right!?
That's why... I inherited that girl's name.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
"...I love music.
Even though I could never stick with anything else...
this is the one thing I could never give up on."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text: When things were brutally tough and exhausting... music was what gave me the strength to keep living.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
"...There's gotta be something we can do too.
Just like how she helped us take a step forward."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
You felt it too, didn't you?
Watching her run... so vividly.
That something welling up inside...!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
"I just can't bring myself to believe that it's useless,
that it's not needed to survive... I just can't! That's why...!!"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
Music definitely has that same power!!
That's why I... why we can too...!!

text_block_list.name: Band Member A
text_block_list.text:
...... I'll cover your travel expenses home.
Then let's head straight to the studio.
I've already... restrung the bass, after all.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, yeah!
Let's push forward too—straight ahead!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amid the lingering fervor... someone from the stands
called out to Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Come here, Or.
—It's a gift from Father.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Dream Journey presented to me...
was a finely crafted golden crown,
gleaming with a dazzling golden light.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Father is...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —I shall accept it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre respectfully knelt and received
the crown from Dream Journey.
The sight was nothing short of divine.
choice_data_list: (Ahh... this is what I wanted to see)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To become a Triple Crown Umamusume and bring hope to people...
that is unquestionably how I feel.
However, what I wanted the most was—"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Bow before me, all of creation!
Kneel before Orfevre!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I only wanted to see her revered in all her free-spirited glory...
To witness the coronation of my king.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Orfe! Orfe! Orfe!
Orfe! Orfe—Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre, congratulations!
Trainer, great work to you too~~!
What a fantastic duo!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the Nippon Derby, for some reason
I've been in the spotlight more, but...
I never imagined we'd share the cheer together.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Draw closer.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
What is the matter?
—Acknowledge the praise of your people.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I quickly got permission from the staff
and stepped into the Winner's Circle.
Orfevre seemed thoroughly pleased—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Later is fine.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"First...
carry Us upon your shoulders."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Become my throne.
Figure out how on your own."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Don't shake me off.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Now, stand.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"What are you dazing off for, commoners?
Keep raising your voices!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
And now—swiftly, fall to your knees.
Come on!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: What a... remarkable sight. Orfevre is... using her Trainer as a chair.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
I have never seen a Triple Crown Umamusume like this.
The entire crowd is buzzing—
and they're all smiling...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Hahaha.
...She was on a whole other level!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"The arrogant one...
was me, huh—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nursing the aches in my body from serving as her throne,
I was heading back to the waiting room with a cheerful Orfevre when—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Um, Orfe-san...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Across the Japanese Derby and Kikuka Sho,
she continued to press Orfevre with unmatched, singular spirit.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...That was incredible!
Total defeat for me, I guess."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"You really are a great king, sir!
Congratulations on achieving the Triple Crown!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Who are you?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You're being overly familiar.
Know your place.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...H-Huh?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: The Triple Crown has been achieved.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Then where do you believe
the King's next path should lead...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before I could caution Orfevre about what happened with Win Variation, she questioned me first. It seems she wants to decide on our next target race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The score has mostly been settled among our generation.
If so, next, Orfevre must aim above...
In other words, take on the challenge of battling the Senior Class.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Why do you fight?
choice_data_list: ...To prove that this is the era of the King.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: And so, what about that race?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is a massive Grand Prix race.
Many of the most talented Umamusume who made their mark that year will be running. And best of all, this year—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The year before last, and last year too... despite receiving so much support,
this is the race I couldn't win...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
In the end, without fail... as a stronger me!
I shall show you a magnificent view!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista—the darling of the era who has led
the racing world with unmatched skill and popularity,
has entered. If I can defeat her—
choice_data_list: It will herald the dawn of a golden age!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"That attitude...
I like it."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
What to add next is... a crown bestowed by the masses, perhaps.
—Very well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the next target race was decided: the year-end Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the excitement still lingering,
as I made my way home...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh.
It's this year's Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mr. C.B.... She, too, is a legendary Umamusume who once became a Triple Crown winner.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I saw it. Your running...
is truly thrilling.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So much "fun" to be had.
...I'm glad the one who appeared this year was you.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Curse the past.
An unwanted congratulation.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
However... if it is on the turf,
I wouldn't mind receiving their blessing.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Striking down the past
would also be quite entertaining.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha.
Nice, that definitely sounds interesting too.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, but... it's not me, right?
For you, that is.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Dictatorship doesn't last forever.
You should just enjoy the future. See ya!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...
A shrewd one, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A showdown between Triple Crown Umamusume...
If that day ever comes for Orfevre...
It was yet another thing to look forward to."
